query:
SELECT i.productName, i.costPrice, i.quantity, (i.costPrice * i.quantity) as value,
  CASE WHEN s.productName IS NOT NULL THEN 'HAS SALES' ELSE 'NO SALES' END as salesStatus
FROM inventory i
LEFT JOIN sales_transactions s ON i.productName = s.productName AND s.branchId = 20 AND s.createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND s.createdAt < '2026-06-01'
WHERE i.branchId = 20 AND i.createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND i.createdAt < '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY i.id, i.productName, i.costPrice, i.quantity
ORDER BY i.productName;
